holds: The native half of the cloud move waits on this.

options.gain: The restyle keeps its simulator and phone.
options.how: Web, Worker, extension and records move now. The native restyle finishes on the Mac, then moves.

options.lose: A split team until the restyle ends, against lanes-start-as-agents for that time.

options.how: A macOS screenshot job, a green milestone.yml and TestFlight from Actions get built; native work pauses until then.
